# 📊 JCC 마케팅 통합 대시보드

## 🗓️ 오늘 및 향후 일정 (Upcoming Targets)
\`\`\`dataview
table scheduled_date as "발행 예정일", status as "상태"
from "Targets"
where scheduled_date >= date(today)
sort scheduled_date asc
\`\`\`

## 📝 최근 생성된 원고 (Recent Manuscripts)
\`\`\`dataview
list from "Manuscripts"
sort date desc
limit 10
\`\`\`
